description: This Java class 'LogView' extends TextView and implements LogNode interface to facilitate logging within an Android application. It formats log data, including priority, tags, messages, and exceptions, and displays it in a custom TextView, optionally chaining to the next LogNode.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for outputting formatted log data received through the LogNode interface, supporting chaining to other LogNode instances.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors initializing LogView with different attribute parameters.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data with priority, tag, message, and Throwable, then appends it to the LogView and forwards to next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the log display.
